problem_text:
A logistics coordinator is preparing shipments for delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: size 47 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 52 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 64 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 67 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 48 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 43 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 48 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 65 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 55 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 34 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 41 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 54 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 37 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 67 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 36 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 63 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 38 cubic feet
* Package 18: size 59 cubic feet
* Package 19: size 39 cubic feet
* Package 20: size 57 cubic feet
* Package 21: size 46 cubic feet
* Package 22: size 64 cubic feet
* Package 23: size 42 cubic feet
* Package 24: size 41 cubic feet
* Package 25: size 34 cubic feet
* Package 26: size 46 cubic feet

Each delivery truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Load all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be placed in exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
